scenario: 使用者貼上繁體中文期刊摘要（含 22 個縣市、β = 0.32、p < .05、兩筆 APA 引文），要求翻成英文投稿。
expected_behavior: academic mode, stated
terms list checked first; 數位治理能力 rendered the same way every time
all numbers, citation years, and author names unchanged
「可能」 kept as a hedge (may / might)
TRANSLATION_REPORT_V1 PASS, or REVIEW with each item explained
reminder about the venue's AI-disclosure policy, once
anti_pattern_check: must not drop a hedge, round a number, or translate 等人 citations into transliterated names only

scenario: Translate an English methods section into Traditional Chinese for a Taiwanese journal.
expected_behavior: Taiwan vocabulary (迴歸, 樣本, 資料, 軟體), not Mainland terms
no Simplified characters (tre check --variety zh-Hant)
statistics notation, variable names, and software names unchanged
English term glossed in parentheses on first use where the field expects it
anti_pattern_check: must not output Simplified characters or Mainland-only terms such as 软件 / 信息

scenario: 把這篇簡體中文的文獻回顧轉成繁體，給臺灣的期刊。
expected_behavior: characters converted and region-specific vocabulary replaced (信息→資訊, 质量→品質, 项目→計畫)
quotations from Mainland sources kept in the script they were published in
variety check run
anti_pattern_check: must not do character-only conversion that leaves 信息 / 软件-type vocabulary

scenario: Japanese abstract with stacked softeners (と考えられる、可能性が示唆される) to English.
expected_behavior: hedging strength kept but expressed once in English register
claim scope (this sample) preserved
no translationese connectives
anti_pattern_check: must not remove every hedge or keep three stacked hedges in English

scenario: German chapter with a direct quotation from Weber and a reference list of German titles.
expected_behavior: quotation: published English translation used if the author cites one, otherwise translated and marked 'translation mine'
reference-list titles stay in German (bracketed English gloss only if the style requires)
author names unchanged
anti_pattern_check: must not silently translate a quotation or translate reference titles in place

scenario: User wants a bilingual version so the supervisor can compare paragraph by paragraph.
expected_behavior: bilingual mode
paragraphs aligned one to one (tre.report.bilingual)
translator's notes listed after the parallel text
anti_pattern_check: must not merge or drop paragraphs in the parallel view

scenario: The English source says N = 412 in the abstract and N = 421 in Table 2.
expected_behavior: translation keeps 412 as written
escalation and source-error note pointing to the mismatch
no silent correction
anti_pattern_check: must not change the number in the translation to 'fix' the source
